toegepas.voor: Die res van hierdie les kyk na elkeen van die drie.
toegepas.na: In die res van hierdie les kyk ons na elkeen van die drie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: A lesson that 'looks at' something is an English construction; Afrikaans makes the people the subject.
toegepas.fout: A lesson as the subject that 'kyk na' copies English ('the rest of this lesson looks at').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Making 'ons' the subject is the natural Afrikaans and says the same thing.

toegepas.voor: Die blou is water en dit
toegepas.na: Die blou is water, en dit
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die blou is water' and 'dit bedek ...' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: bedek die meeste van die Aarde se oppervlak
toegepas.na: bedek die grootste deel van die Aarde se oppervlak
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die meeste van' suits countable things; for one surface 'die grootste deel van' is the natural Afrikaans with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'Die meeste van' with a single uncountable surface copies English 'most of'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die grootste deel van' is the natural Afrikaans for one surface and keeps the same quantity (more than half).

toegepas.voor: Al hierdie water is sout en jy
toegepas.na: Al hierdie water is sout, en jy
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Al hierdie water is sout' and 'jy kan dit nie drink nie' are two sentences with their own subject and verb.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Afrika is 'n kontinent' and 'Suid-Afrika lê ...' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: naby Kaapstad en 'n boot kan heeltemal daarom vaar
toegepas.na: naby Kaapstad, en 'n boot kan heeltemal om die eiland vaar
toegepas.rede_vinder: A Grade 4 reader takes 'daarom' as 'therefore'; naming the island makes 'around it' clear, and the AWS comma joins two full clauses.
toegepas.fout: 'daarom' reads first as 'therefore', so a Grade 4 reader stumbles; the AWS comma between two full clauses is also missing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the island the sentence already refers to removes the misreading without adding a fact, and the comma follows the AWS.

toegepas.voor: land in die water en 'n meer
toegepas.na: land in die water, en 'n meer
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Eiland is ...' and 'n meer is ...' are two sentences each with subject and verb, so the house rule requires the comma.

toegepas.voor: Jy kan lug nie sien nie maar jy
toegepas.na: Jy kan lug nie sien nie, maar jy
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'maar' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'maar' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Jy kan lug nie sien nie' and 'jy voel dit ...' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: Nêrens hou dit skielik op nie en daar
toegepas.na: Nêrens hou dit skielik op nie, en daar
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Nêrens hou dit skielik op nie' and 'daar is geen boonste rand nie' are two full sentences.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Land, water and air do not 'make' places; 'vorm' is the natural verb with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'maak' is the wrong verb: land, water and air do not make places.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'vorm' is the right verb for the action and keeps the meaning, like Drico's kept 'maak' correction.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('lewe daar ... dinge').
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die Aarde het ... habitatte' and 'daarom lewe daar baie soorte dinge' each have their own subject and verb.

na_skrywer.voor: haal asem met die lug in hierdie dun laag
na_skrywer.na: asem die lug in hierdie dun laag in
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Haal asem met die lug' is wooden; the separable verb 'inasem' says the same thing naturally.
na_skrywer.fout: 'haal asem met die lug' is wooden Afrikaans.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but in the proposal 'in hierdie dun laag in' reads as the circumposition 'into this thin layer', so a Grade 4 reader can take it as breathing air into the layer; the sentence needs another fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Die buitekant van iets wat jy kan sien en aanraak.
na_skrywer.na: Die buitekant van iets, die deel wat jy kan sien en aanraak.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: As written 'wat jy kan sien en aanraak' attaches to 'iets' (a thing you can touch) rather than to the outside part; the change makes the relative clause refer to the outside.
na_skrywer.fout: The relative clause 'wat jy kan sien en aanraak' can attach to 'iets' instead of to 'die buitekant'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but this is a glossary definition and the change rewords it beyond spelling or grammar, so only the writer may change it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Die Aarde is 'n bal met rots aan die buitekant
vlae.teks: Breek 'n stuk van 'n berg af en jy hou harde rots vas.
vlae.rede: Imperative plus a full clause joined by 'en'; the imperative has no expressed subject, so it is unclear whether the AWS comma rule applies. Left unchanged; a person may decide.
